maintenanceAssessment: Admits the Kotlin 2.4.20 -> 2.4.21 upgrade of org.jetbrains.kotlin.multiplatform and org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose, and the Spotless 8.10.3 -> 8.10.4 upgrade of com.diffplug.spotless, to clear the release-lint NewerVersionAvailable failures on Kotlin and Spotless. Kotlin is the upstream JetBrains 2.4.21 release on Maven Central; the resolved kotlin-stdlib 2.4.21 jar is pinned by its verified SHA-256 bd8250210584cb659847dce9cda660f8e9906e5def7fbebcea93dc6dcb6a88a3 and is the only packaged runtime input that moves. The resolved Kotlin build-tool, compiler-embeddable, scripting and compose-compiler plugin artifacts are build-only and never enter the Android redistribution closure. The Android closure keeps its 195-component inventory with kotlin-stdlib re-pointed to 2.4.21; resource profile and record r13 supersede r12 with the moved stdlib members and dependencies.pb table derived by substitution, not from a candidate. Spotless 8.10.4 is a build-only formatter plugin; the explicit ktfmt version and all Android runtime dependencies are unchanged. Gradle 9.8.1, AGP 9.4.1, Compose 1.12.1, the reviewed Gradle wrapper launcher and every GOV.12 asset pin are unchanged. Upstream maintenance remains monitored by Dependabot and the security workflow; this records admission, not a claim of latest versions or no vulnerabilities. The CodeQL Kotlin workaround in .github/workflows/security.yml is not changed by this review and still names the Kotlin 2.4.20 bundle; its applicability to 2.4.21 is for the security owner to confirm.

closure-sbom.reason: Android runtime closure changes only by the kotlin-stdlib version re-pointing from 2.4.20 to 2.4.21, with every other app runtime component unchanged. The app and shared lockfiles and verification metadata were regenerated with --write-locks, the new checksums are additive, and superseded entries are kept. CI repeats the strict resolveDependencies run, the closure and the SBOM gates.

compatibility.reason: Kotlin 2.4.21 and Spotless 8.10.4 are the upstream successors of the admitted 2.4.20 and 8.10.3 in the same plugin lines. Gradle 9.8.1 and AGP 9.4.1 are unchanged. Compilation, lint and the Compose Hot Reload preview are required CI gates.

compilation.reason: The Kotlin and Spotless upgrades are the change under review. Local Windows JDK 21 validation of the complete ci.yml command set is recorded by the coordinator; CI on Windows and Linux repeats spotlessCheck, shared desktop and host tests, debug test compilation, :app:lintRelease, assembleRelease, bundleRelease and the bytecode check.

licence-provenance.reason: The kotlin-stdlib inventory entry is re-pointed to the 2.4.21 jar digest and its published POM digest from the Gradle cache. Resource profile and record r13 supersede r12 and keep every r12 archive expectation outside the stdlib origin rules. CI repeats verifyAndroidLicences, the strict licence and resource gate, the stage step and release archive verification.

local-runtime.reason: No Android device or emulator is part of this validation; no installed-app runtime observation is claimed.

performance.reason: No build or app performance measurement was taken for this change.

migration.reason: No persisted data, schema, protocol or app code changes; only the Kotlin and Spotless plugin and stdlib versions move.

security.reason: Kotlin and Spotless are pinned by verified SHA-256 checksums in the strict verification metadata. No feed, publisher, public import or native payload changes beyond the stdlib version. The existing CodeQL/security workflow and Dependabot monitoring apply.
